name: Encouraging One Another
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively encourage one another through the power of the Holy Spirit, fostering joy, peace, and hope in the community of faith. The word of Christ is to dwell richly within us, guiding us to teach and admonish one another with wisdom, worship, and heartfelt gratitude. Additionally, believers are urged not to neglect gathering together but to continually exhort and strengthen each other, especially as the return of Christ draws near.
